2024 Snap Convergence Research Project

Sponsored by the Chico STEM Connections Collaborative or (CSC^2). I was able to participate in research in data communication and presentation skills. I worked alongside the Center for Healthy Communities or (CHC).

CHC is the office at Chico state that manages the EBT benefits, a Farmers Market program, and food out reach services. In 2022 they conducted a survey with a number of California schools in partnership with a coresearcher at University of California Los Angeles. They wanted to know more information as to why people who were eligible for EBT were not accessing this resource.

My job was to make a website pages that were presentable to others so that they can continue to get funding for research such as this one. Then at the end of this research I had to give a ten minute lecture as to what I learned as a requirement from CSC^2.
